So, yet another black man gets killed by police, during a traffic stop. When will it be enough? 

Another had his military career threatened for a bullshit excuse of a traffic stop that only got *one* officer fired.

When is enough enough? 
#BlackLivesMatter #DaunteWright

This was what I was referring to when I said only one cop had been fired. Both need to be. They profiled this man, threatened him if he brought action against him, treated him like a criminal and both deserve to be fired for it. 

#BlackLivesMatter

Did you know, Peter Liang remains the only NYPD officer convicted of a police involved killing in over 15 years?  And only *5 in the entire US* have been convicted of police involved killings in 15 years (as of Jun 2020)? 

This needs to change. 

#BlackLivesMatter

"He had outstanding warrants!"

So? He still didn't deserve to die. 

"He was resisting arrest!"

So? He still didn't deserve to die. 

Stop the damn victim blaming. 

#BlackLivesMatter
